about_the_game:
Take on the role of sentient data and escape the tyranny of your programming...or be deleted trying! Climb on familiar-looking video game blocks and break into regions where no code should ever reach.

Collect coins during your climb to unlock powerful upgrades called "Boons." There are many different Boon combinations, making every playthrough unique. What combos will you discover?

You must also choose what "Banes" you encounter. You control how the difficulty spikes—so pick your poison wisely! The right Boon/Bane combination could be the difference between the taste of freedom and permanent destruction. 

Collect fun colors, hats, and palettes to personalize your experience. Collect them all as you play—yep, no microtransactions here! Show your individuality as you fight the system!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or NVIDIA GT 730 (1GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or integrated audio (e.g., 16-bit stereo with 48KHz playback)
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: -

short_description: Jump, climb, dash, and fight for your digital freedom in this challenging rogue-like platformer. Unlock powerful upgrades and discover broken synergies. Will you escape the game, or will your data be deleted forever?
